summary: Infrastructure for businesses to launch branded retail electricity plans.
editor_note: Retail electricity becomes embedded infrastructure: the platform combines enrollment, billing, power procurement, market operations, and regulatory work behind a brand-owned plan. Public product pages, developer docs, and a live dashboard make the operating layer inspectable. The bet is sharper than a utility referral, but expansion may resist repeatable software because regulation, grid economics, and failure modes vary by territory.

product_evidence.claim: Light combines enrollment, billing, wholesale power procurement, market operations, and regulatory support for businesses launching branded electricity plans.
The public product surface includes developer documentation and a live dashboard login in addition to the operating-model overview.

market_context.primary_user: Consumer brands and energy companies that want to offer retail electricity under their own customer relationship.
market_context.differentiation: A full operating layer absorbs regulated supplier, billing, procurement, and market complexity behind a brand-owned electricity plan.
market_context.why_now: Load growth, electrification, and volatile power markets are increasing the value of software that lets new brands participate without rebuilding utility operations.

risks.claim: Market-by-market regulation and grid economics may make expansion slower and less repeatable than the software packaging suggests.
risks.basis: The platform owns operational and regulatory functions whose rules and failure modes vary by electricity territory.
